role: A RegistrySimple that returns a fixed default object when a key is missing. Its only user is BlockDispenser.dispenseBehaviorRegistry, whose default is BehaviorDefaultDispenseItem.
scope_reason: The dispenser behavior registry is only consulted when a dispenser fires, and dispensers need redstone power, which world.conf switches off (redstone = off, no block ever receives power); the native tile entity keeps the dispenser's slots but nothing dispenses.
notes: Unreachable in this game: BlockDispenser.dispense runs only from TileEntityDispenser's powered dispense, and no block is ever powered.
